subject: MedSentry retention assistance — rate carveout request
messages:
From: Lisa Shaw <lisa.shaw@medsentry.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@medsentry.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: retention assistance and pricing alignment

Olga — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We had a follow-up with our GTM team and leadership this morning and there is a real risk we won’t extend past the pilot unless we get a short-term pricing accommodation plus a committed support plan.

Concrete ask: a time-limited 30% one-off platform discount for the first 12 months of the annual contract (to bridge budget timing) + access to a named TAM for the first 3 months. If Redwood can do that we can commit to a 24-month term after the bridge.

I’ve attached the latest SOW and internal TCO snapshot. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through.

Attachments: [MedSentry_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)], [TCO_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

—Lisa
Lisa Shaw
Head of Partnerships, MedSentry Health
lisa.shaw@medsentry.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: retention assistance and pricing alignment

Forwarding MedSentry’s ask — they are at risk of churn from pilot-to-paid unless we provide a short bridge. Key points below and my assessment:

- External ask: 30% discount for 12 months + named TAM for 3 months in exchange for 24-month commitment after the bridge.
- ARR impact (naive): gives up ~30% of revenue on first-year run-rate for a customer we expect to scale — but churn risk is material.
- Alternative we should consider: 20% discount + 6 months of TAM + committed min usage floor (to reduce upside loss).

I’m escalating because this exceeds my delegated commercial limits and will need VP/CFO signoff. Ben — can you run a quick margin/usage sensitivity and include projected token consumption vs threshold? Marissa — can you confirm whether Customer Success has the capacity to provide a named TAM for the requested window?

Attached: commercial_summary.xlsx (high level numbers).

Thanks —
Olga
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: retention assistance and pricing alignment

On Fri, Apr 9, 2027 at 11:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I’m escalating because this exceeds my delegated commercial limits and will need VP/CFO signoff.

Thanks — quick notes from my side:
- I ran three scenarios in the attached sheet. Worst case (no upsell) we lose ~18% gross margin year one on the bridge. Base case (50% chance of expansion) net impact ~8% year one; upside case is net positive after year two.
- Strong preference for a smaller discount + contractual minimum (we can do a usage floor that preserves revenue if they underdeliver).
- Suggestion: approve up to 25% for max 9 months, conditioned on a signed 24-month commitment and a minimum monthly usage floor equal to their pilot average * 0.8.

I’ll stand by to update numbers for Markus/Finance.

—Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: retention assistance and pricing alignment

Appreciate the context. Customer Success can assign a TAM for 3 months on a phased schedule but we need to be explicit about scope (TAM hours/week and escalation SLA).

I agree we should avoid a straight 30% for 12 months. Ben’s counter (25% max for 9 months + 24-month commitment + min usage floor) is reasonable operationally.

This requires VP/CFO approval given the term length and revenue carveout. Markus — can you weigh in? If you’re comfortable with the 25%/9mo path, Legal will draft an amendment with the minimum usage floor and a cancellation clawback.

—Marissa
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:53:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: retention assistance and pricing alignment

Thanks team — I reviewed Ben’s sensitivity and Marissa’s operational constraints. Approve the following commercial exception:

- Approved: 25% platform discount for a 9-month bridge period.
- Conditions: must be tied to (1) a signed 24-month master subscription within 14 days of amendment, (2) a minimum monthly usage floor set at 80% of their pilot average, and (3) a clawback clause that recovers pro-rated discount if they terminate before 12 months post-signature.
- TAM: Customer Success to provide named TAM for first 3 months, capped at 10 hours/week.

Legal: please draft amendment referencing DEAL-8472 and include the cancellation/clawback language. Finance — I expect the revenue recognition/forecast adjustments to be reflected in the next weekly close.

I’m copying in the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign room to expedite.

—Markus Klein
VP, Commercials & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Shaw <lisa.shaw@medsentry.com>
Cc: contracts@medsentry.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: temporary bridge discount and TAM — next steps

Hi Lisa — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Good news — leadership has approved a temporary retention bridge under the following terms: 

1) 25% platform discount for 9 months starting on your contract effective date.
2) 24-month master subscription to be signed within 14 days of the amendment.
3) Minimum monthly usage floor at 80% of your pilot average.
4) Clawback: pro-rated recovery of discount if customer terminates within 12 months of signature.
5) Named TAM for first 3 months (max 10 hrs/week) to assist onboarding and model tuning.

We’ve prepared an approval memo and sent an amendment into your DocuSign room for signature: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/ABC-123-MEDSENTRY. Please review the amendment and route to contracts. Attached is the approval memo that summarizes the commercial exception.

Attachments: [approval_memo.pdf (pdf)]

If you want to discuss the implementation details or the TAM scope, happy to block 30 minutes this week.

Best —
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
